isolation.methodExtraction: Only named VoltHero methods, pure Cards arithmetic and Volt timing; all collaborators are inert data doubles.
isolation.renderer: Graphics command recorder; verifies geometry/palette budgets, not GPU appearance or phone performance.

lifecycleReview.battleKey: WeakMap<Node, VoltField> keyed by battle Field; explicitly deleted on battle NODE_DESTROYED.
lifecycleReview.clock: advanceTo takes absolute accumulated hero battle time. Equal/older timestamps are ignored, so same-start heroes cannot double-advance.
lifecycleReview.emptyBattlefield: While running, HeroBase invokes updateQueues even without targets. advanceTo ages/prunes fields with an empty list and consumes pulse boundaries without banking contacts.
lifecycleReview.idleGap: The next leave after all fields expire resets the next pulse to current battle time + .5; long empty gaps never replay historical pulses.
lifecycleReview.owner: Fields require a valid active owner. Nearby refresh coalesces one footprint and retains strongest damage/credit; destruction of that retained owner releases the coalesced slot.
lifecycleReview.ultimateDeath: Field creation precedes direct lethal damage; dead queued targets retarget or skip. A residual kill before a queued strike cannot create another field.
lifecycleReview.terminalState: Pause/pick/win/lose stop simulation. Residual continues past strike queue/presentation only while running and does not delay victory; remaining visuals may freeze at win until battle teardown.
lifecycleReview.assumption: All roster heroes start the same battle clock and receive the same battle dt. Dynamically inserting a hero with a zero clock mid-battle is not implemented or claimed.
